def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Locate separator rows and columns: the interior of every tile is color 1,
    # while separator lines contain no 1s.
    rs = [r for r in range(h) if 1 not in grid[r]]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != 1 for r in range(h))]

    # Lines may have occasional unmarked crossings, so use the regular grid
    # spacing inferred from the most common difference.
    def regular(lines):
        diffs = [b-a for a, b in zip(lines, lines[1:])]
        step = max(set(diffs), key=diffs.count)
        start = lines[0]
        return [x for x in range(start, lines[-1] + 1, step)]

    rs = regular(rs)
    cs = regular(cs)

    # Each crossing marker contributes to the output cell at the same
    # position in the grid of tiles. A plain frame crossing is background.
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rs) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cs) - 1):
            vals = [grid[rs[i]][cs[j]], grid[rs[i]][cs[j+1]],
                    grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j]], grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j+1]]]
            marker = next((v for v in vals if v not in (1, 4, 6, 8)), None)
            row.append(marker if marker is not None else 4)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Separator lines contain no interior cells (color 1). Their marker
    # intersections form the smaller encoded grid.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if 1 not in grid[r]]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != 1 for r in range(h))]

    def step_of(values):
        diffs = [b - a for a, b in zip(values, values[1:])]
        from collections import Counter
        return Counter(diffs).most_common(1)[0][0]

    row_step = step_of(rows)
    col_step = step_of(cols)
    rows = list(range(rows[0], h, row_step))
    cols = list(range(cols[0], w, col_step))

    # The last separator is the far edge of the repeated tiling. At every
    # other crossing, preserve a marker and use the interior color otherwise.
    return [
        [grid[r][c] if grid[r][c] not in (4, 6, 8) else 1
         for c in cols[:-1]]
        for r in rows[:-1]
    ]
